+            transitions = sum(((seq[k] == 0) & (seq[k + 1] == 1)) for k in range(8))
+            if phase == 0:
+                keep = (p2 * p4 * p6 == 0) & (p4 * p6 * p8 == 0)
+            else:

+    """One continuous DFS walk that visits every medial-skeleton edge."""
+    skel = zhang_suen(mask)
+    rc = np.argwhere(skel)
+    ids = {tuple(p): i for i, p in enumerate(rc)}
+    adj = [[] for _ in rc]
